headline: Oil Registers First Weekly Gain in November on Supply Uncertainty
summary: Brent crude oil recorded an increase of about 3% for the week, marking its first weekly gain in November, driven by ongoing geopolitical concerns over supply.
why: Crude oil price trends influence global energy input costs, transportation expenses, and broad industrial production overhead.

impacts.name: Brent crude
impacts.why: Oil futures posted weekly gains driven by geopolitical supply disruption fears.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Geopolitical tensions and supply uncertainties in key exporting regions drove crude prices higher over the week.
